# sink_amber_pump_bottle — repaired realism QA

Evidence: f0008, f0082, f0168. Calibrations and source images are retained in ../measurements.json and ../evidence/.

- Added an inner vessel profile with 1 mm walls.
- Replaced baked photo illumination on amber material with transmissive tinted polymer.

Amber round bottle, screw collar and black spring pump. Two-view pump-top triangulation gives z~1.247 m. Pump stroke and collar unscrewing are not observed; only pump translation is constrained. Collar is fixed to body; no invented screw mechanism.

Physics: Estimated 0.36 kg contents plus 0.06 kg vessel/pump; photo cannot resolve glass versus amber polymer. Mass 0.42 kg, friction 0.3, restitution 0.1. All are estimates, not measured product values. See model.json physics for COM, density and material model.

No manipulation was observed. Joints and ranges remain unverified assumptions. See ../qa_report.json and ../qa_summary.md for measured comparisons and outstanding limitations.

## Round 2

Source-pose grades: silhouette B, proportions A, color_texture B, articulation B, physics B, collision B, instances B. Mean silhouette IoU 0.812.



Remaining: Joint axes/ranges/return forces are estimated; no actuation was observed. B for cap/pump means plausible topology only, not dynamic calibration. Mass, friction and centre of mass are estimates; real product weight unavailable.
